manufactureAndInstallationReasoning.finish: cementitious leveling/render plus aged matte exterior protective coating
manufactureAndInstallationReasoning.mountingAndInterfaces: coating terminates at real sash/seal, balcony drip/slab and construction-joint geometry; macro variation may not invent seams or installation depth
manufactureAndInstallationReasoning.geometryVsMaterial: openings, returns, drips, joints and penetrations are geometry; aggregate, coating grain, micro-normal and low-frequency application/chalking variation are material response
manufactureAndInstallationReasoning.exposureAndAging: macro variation is non-directional finish variation only; runoff, sill streaks, splash and metal-source residue remain separate cause-based weathering
manufactureAndInstallationReasoning.orientation: all texture fields derive from the Danchi-local physical UV0 field, not camera or sun direction

shaderReasoning.lightingModel: Unity Surface Shader Standard BRDF / built-in rendering pipeline
shaderReasoning.hazard: Built-in Standard computes both secondary albedo and secondary normal from the _DetailAlbedoMap transformed UV. A 7.9 m detail-albedo scale would therefore also force the intended 0.22 m detail normal to 7.9 m.
shaderReasoning.solution: Use a dedicated Standard-lighting surface shader whose _MainTex, _DetailNormalMap and _MacroVariationMap each receive independent texture transforms while preserving metallic/smoothness, primary normal, reflection probes and Standard BRDF response.
shaderReasoning.compatibilityMetadata: _NORMALMAP and _DETAIL_MULX2 remain enabled on the material only so older source validators that use those flags as readiness metadata continue to fail closed; the custom shader samples both normal maps explicitly.

angularResponse.front: matte neutral coating with low-amplitude finish variation and no panel-stamped recurrence
angularResponse.oblique: 0.22 m detail-normal frequency remains readable independently of the 7.9 m neutral albedo modulation
angularResponse.grazing: real normals, geometry and dielectric Fresnel create highlights; macro variation must not form a highlight stripe

automaticFailConditions: formal facade remains on built-in Standard after the physical-UV save instead of the independent-frequency facade shader
macro variation map is missing or reuses primary albedo
detail normal no longer resolves to 0.22 m physical repeat
macro variation no longer resolves to 7.9 m physical repeat
combined exact primary+macro recurrence falls below 100 m
source-side anti-repeat checks are used to clear a rendered repetition defect without actual 4K and temporal evidence

failureInjection: switch formal material back to Standard after save and require formal pre-cull failure
set _DetailNormalMap tiling to the 7.9 m macro scale and require failure
set _MacroVariationMap tiling to 1.0 (2.4 m) and require failure
bind primary albedo as _MacroVariationMap and require failure
remove mipmaps or reduce anisotropy below 8 and require failure

renderReview.temporalEvidence: check texture swimming, moire and whether either the 7.9 m modulation or 0.22 m normal field becomes visibly periodic during motion
